Revelations in Fall#000.src: They had the potential to be dangerous. Sometimes, they were. But more often than not, they were heroes. They used their power to protect people in need.
Revelations in Fall#000.dst: Ils pouvaient être dangereux. Parfois, ils l'étaient. Mais le plus souvent, c'étaient des héros. Ils usaient de leur pouvoir pour protéger ceux qui en avaient besoin.

Revelations in Fall#002.src: Attend the meeting in the resistance camp at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Revelations in Fall#002.dst: Assistez à la réunion au camp de la résistance en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Revelations in Fall#003.src: Hello, everyone. Thank you for being here today.
Revelations in Fall#003.dst: Bonjour à tous. Merci d'être là aujourd'hui.
Revelations in Fall#003.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#004.src: It has been growing increasingly clear that there is very little we can do here to make a larger impact on Fruma.
Revelations in Fall#004.dst: Il devient de plus en plus clair que nous ne pouvons pas faire grand-chose d'ici pour peser davantage sur Fruma.
Revelations in Fall#004.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#005.src: We have been doing good for the people of Auburn! But our resources are limited, and our opportunities to take action are even more so.
Revelations in Fall#005.dst: Nous faisons du bien aux gens d'Auburn! Mais nos ressources sont limitées, et nos occasions d'agir le sont encore plus.
Revelations in Fall#005.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#006.src: Additionally, our risks of operation grow by the day. I do not regret taking in {u} as a member, but it's no secret that we risk more scrutiny by having them here.
Revelations in Fall#006.dst: De plus, nos risques augmentent de jour en jour. Je ne regrette pas d'avoir accueilli {u} parmi nous, mais chacun sait que sa présence ici nous expose davantage.
Revelations in Fall#006.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#007.src: Zeph and {u} learned yesterday that an Inquisitor is arriving in the area. We don't know what for exactly, but their presence further endangers our cause.
Revelations in Fall#007.dst: Zeph et {u} ont appris hier qu'un Inquisiteur arrive dans la région. Nous ignorons pourquoi au juste, mais sa présence met notre cause encore plus en danger.
Revelations in Fall#007.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#008.src: At the festival, I received word from a contact in the Roughworks. There's a group similar to ours there, run by an old friend of mine - they're called the Steel Feather.
Revelations in Fall#008.dst: Au festival, j'ai eu des nouvelles d'un contact à Roughworks. Il y a là-bas un groupe semblable au nôtre, dirigé par un vieil ami - on les appelle la Plume d'acier.
Revelations in Fall#008.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#009.src: They have resources we don't, and are situated in a much more favorable position. If we're able to cross through to the Roughworks, they've agreed to host us and help plan our next moves.
Revelations in Fall#009.dst: Ils ont des ressources que nous n'avons pas, et une position bien plus favorable. Si nous parvenons à passer à Roughworks, ils acceptent de nous accueillir et de nous aider à préparer la suite.
Revelations in Fall#009.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#010.src: So, what are our next moves? I don't know what you expect us to do there that we're not already able to do here.
Revelations in Fall#010.dst: Et c'est quoi, la suite? Je ne vois pas ce que tu attends de nous là-bas qu'on ne puisse pas déjà faire ici.
Revelations in Fall#010.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#011.src: I'm still workshopping ideas, but they involve the Crown Festival. If we move quickly, we'll be able to catch it in the Roughworks.
Revelations in Fall#011.dst: Je peaufine encore mes idées, mais elles concernent le Festival de la Couronne. Si nous faisons vite, nous arriverons à temps pour celui de Roughworks.
Revelations in Fall#011.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#012.src: Of course, traveling to a different district presents its own risks and dangers... if any of you wish to stay here, I will respect that decision.
Revelations in Fall#012.dst: Bien sûr, partir pour un autre district comporte ses propres risques... si certains d'entre vous veulent rester ici, je respecterai ce choix.
Revelations in Fall#012.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#013.src: Ha! And leave you to strategize all on your own? I had foreseen something along these lines, so I have already made arrangements with my work. I will join you, miss.
Revelations in Fall#013.dst: Ha! Et vous laisser établir vos stratégies toute seule? J'avais prévu quelque chose de ce genre, alors je me suis déjà arrangé avec mon travail. Je vous accompagne, madame.
Revelations in Fall#013.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#014.src: And I'm definitely not sitting this one out, are you kidding? I'll follow you wherever you go, Syndra.
Revelations in Fall#014.dst: Et moi, pas question de rester sur la touche, tu plaisantes? Je te suivrai partout, Syndra.
Revelations in Fall#014.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#015.src: I- I'll go too! Wh- what's the point of hav- having magic if I don't use it for our c- c- cause?
Revelations in Fall#015.dst: J- je viens aussi! A- à quoi bon av- avoir de la magie si je ne m'en sers pas pour notre c- c- cause?
Revelations in Fall#015.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#016.src: Eh. Don't see myself bein' much use out there, to tell you the truth, Synny. And I figure you need someone to hold down the fort while you're gone, anyhow. So I'll stay.
Revelations in Fall#016.dst: Eh. J'me vois pas trop servir à grand-chose là-bas, pour être honnête, Synny. Et puis faut bien quelqu'un pour garder la maison pendant votre absence. Alors je reste.
Revelations in Fall#016.speaker: Kaio

Revelations in Fall#017.src: That would be appreciated, Kaio. I'll feel more comfortable leaving, knowing the LEaves in the Wind is safe in your care.
Revelations in Fall#017.dst: Je t'en serais reconnaissante, Kaio. Je partirai plus sereine en sachant Feuilles au vent entre tes mains.
Revelations in Fall#017.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#020.src: You'll... need my medicine. So I'll go...
Revelations in Fall#020.dst: Vous... aurez besoin de mes remèdes. Alors je viens...
Revelations in Fall#020.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#021.src: Sui... you can stay, if you want. I don't want to force you-
Revelations in Fall#021.dst: Sui... tu peux rester, si tu veux. Je ne veux pas te forcer-
Revelations in Fall#021.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#022.src: N-no! I want to go with you! I just... I need to say goodbye to some people. Before we leave.
Revelations in Fall#022.dst: N-non! Je veux venir avec vous! C'est juste que... je dois dire au revoir à certaines personnes. Avant de partir.
Revelations in Fall#022.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#023.dst: ... D'accord. Si tu en es sûre.
Revelations in Fall#023.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#026.src: I'm forever in your debt. Thank you, again, for offering your help.
Revelations in Fall#026.dst: Je te serai éternellement redevable. Merci encore de nous offrir ton aide.
Revelations in Fall#026.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#027.src: In Wynn, we have stories of people who could use magic like you. It came naturally to them, and they didn't need a focus for it.
Revelations in Fall#027.dst: On raconte à Wynn des histoires de gens qui utilisaient la magie comme toi. Ça leur venait naturellement, sans besoin de focaliseur.

Revelations in Fall#028.src: Sigh... I wish I could disagree. But you're right, I need you to join us.
Revelations in Fall#028.dst: Soupir... J'aimerais pouvoir te contredire. Mais tu as raison, j'ai besoin que tu viennes.
Revelations in Fall#028.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#029.src: I still need to make preparations before we leave- namely, arranging passage across the border. I have a contact that I can... hopefully convince to help.
Revelations in Fall#029.dst: Il me reste des préparatifs avant de partir- notamment, obtenir un passage à travers la frontière. J'ai un contact que je peux... j'espère, convaincre de nous aider.
Revelations in Fall#029.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#030.src: You- you can't pos- possibly mean-
Revelations in Fall#030.dst: Tu- tu ne pa- parles quand même pas de-
Revelations in Fall#030.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#031.src: Yes, Zeph, I do. It will be fine.
Revelations in Fall#031.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#032.src: As for the rest of you, you should make your own preparations. I don't know how long the window of opportunity will be, so make the most of the time left.
Revelations in Fall#032.dst: Quant aux autres, faites vos propres préparatifs. J'ignore combien de temps durera cette fenêtre, alors profitez au mieux du temps qui reste.
Revelations in Fall#032.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#033.src: Hmn... Zeph, why the concern? We all know miss Syndra knows what she's doing! If she claims to have the situation covered, then I see no reason to doubt her!
Revelations in Fall#033.dst: Hmn... Zeph, pourquoi t'inquiéter? Nous savons tous que madame Syndra sait ce qu'elle fait! Si elle affirme maîtriser la situation, je ne vois aucune raison d'en douter!
Revelations in Fall#033.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#035.src: Ah, no matter! Come now, other children... and {u}, of course! Let us all take some time to say our goodbyes. We don't know when we'll be back, after all!
Revelations in Fall#035.dst: Ah, peu importe! Allons, les enfants... et {u}, bien sûr! Prenons tous un moment pour faire nos adieux. Après tout, nous ne savons pas quand nous reviendrons!
Revelations in Fall#035.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#036.src: If we'll be back at all...
Revelations in Fall#036.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#037.src: Sui... we will be back. I'll make sure of it! And you know I always keep my word for matters such as these.
Revelations in Fall#037.dst: Sui... nous reviendrons. J'y veillerai! Et tu sais que je tiens toujours parole pour ce genre de choses.
Revelations in Fall#037.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#038.src: We'll be fine, Sui. We always are.
Revelations in Fall#038.dst: Tout ira bien, Sui. Comme toujours.
Revelations in Fall#038.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#040.src: Talk with Zeph outside the base at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Revelations in Fall#040.dst: Parlez avec Zeph devant la base en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Revelations in Fall#041.src: I don't know if I- I'm ready for this.
Revelations in Fall#041.dst: Je ne sais pas si je- je suis prête pour ça.
Revelations in Fall#041.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#042.src: But I have to be! I... I have to.
Revelations in Fall#042.dst: Mais il le faut! Je... il le faut.
Revelations in Fall#042.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#044.src: So... I r- really don't trust the Sovereign, and I- I- I'm afraid he might do s- so- something to Syndra.
Revelations in Fall#044.dst: Bon... je ne f- fais vraiment pas confiance au Souverain, et j- j- j'ai peur qu'il f- fa- fasse quelque chose à Syndra.
Revelations in Fall#044.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#045.src: It- it's silly, but... if y- you and I can fi- find a way over the wall without having to ask him d- directly, we could avoid a- a potential con- conflict.
Revelations in Fall#045.dst: C'est- c'est bête, mais... si t- toi et moi on t- trouve un moyen de passer la muraille sans lui d- demander directement, on pourrait éviter un é- éventuel con- conflit.
Revelations in Fall#045.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#046.src: And besides, it's not like I have a- any- anything better to do...
Revelations in Fall#046.dst: Et puis, c'est pas comme si j'avais m- mi- mieux à faire...
Revelations in Fall#046.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#047.src: So! L- let's head into town and s- s- see if we can-
Revelations in Fall#047.dst: Alors! A- allons en ville et v- v- voyons si on peut-
Revelations in Fall#047.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#048.src: Um... excuse me, s-sorry to interrupt- I overheard you were... going into town?
Revelations in Fall#048.dst: Euh... pardon, d-désolée de vous interrompre- je vous ai entendus dire que vous... alliez en ville?
Revelations in Fall#048.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#049.src: Sui! Y- yeah, we were pl- planning on it.
Revelations in Fall#049.dst: Sui! O- oui, c'était l'i- idée.
Revelations in Fall#049.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#050.src: If... if it wouldn't be too much trouble... could I maybe go with you? I, ah... have some people I want to... say goodbye to.
Revelations in Fall#050.dst: Si... si ça ne vous dérange pas trop... je pourrais peut-être venir avec vous? J'ai, euh... des gens à qui je voudrais... dire au revoir.
Revelations in Fall#050.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#051.src: Oh... the people at the R- Re- the Red Fox?
Revelations in Fall#051.dst: Oh... les gens du R- Re- du Renard Roux?
Revelations in Fall#051.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#052.src: It's... a restaurant I, um, frequent. The owners are... nice. I wanted to thank them, for, ha, everything.
Revelations in Fall#052.dst: C'est... un restaurant où je vais, euh, souvent. Les patrons sont... gentils. Je voulais les remercier pour, ha, tout.
Revelations in Fall#052.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#053.src: It's built atop one of th- the tallest tr- trees in {p}, too... so it'll w- wo- work for my idea too. It's jus- just outside {p}'s gates.
Revelations in Fall#053.dst: Il est perché sur un d- des plus grands ar- arbres de {p}, en plus... donc il f- fe- fera l'affaire pour mon idée. C'est ju- juste devant les portes de {p}.
Revelations in Fall#053.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#054.src: Head to the Red Fox treetop café at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Revelations in Fall#054.dst: Rendez-vous au Renard Roux, le café perché dans les arbres, en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Revelations in Fall#055.src: L- let's all meet up at the Re- Red Fox café. It's just ou- out- outside the {p} Gates.
Revelations in Fall#055.dst: R- retrouvons-nous tous au café du Re- Renard Roux. C'est ju- jus- juste devant les portes de {p}.
Revelations in Fall#055.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#057.src: So, wh- what do you think? It's a n- nice view from up here, is- isn't it?
Revelations in Fall#057.dst: Alors, t'en p- penses quoi? Belle vue d'ici, n- n'est-ce pas?
Revelations in Fall#057.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#058.src: I... bring the others here quite often. They, um, serve the best food in {p}...
Revelations in Fall#058.dst: J'y... amène souvent les autres. Ils servent, euh, la meilleure cuisine de {p}...
Revelations in Fall#058.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#059.src: Yeah... I'll m- mi- miss our late-night snack runs. Heh.
Revelations in Fall#059.dst: Ouais... nos virées gourmandes de nuit vont me m- man- manquer. Hé.
Revelations in Fall#059.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#060.src: S- Sui, do you... want us t- to stay? We can-
Revelations in Fall#060.dst: S- Sui, tu veux... qu'on r- reste? On peut-
Revelations in Fall#060.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#061.src: N-no! No, no, it's... fine. I'll... go find Chen on my own. You two, um, had something you were going to do, right?
Revelations in Fall#061.dst: N-non! Non, non, ça... va. Je vais... aller voir Chen toute seule. Vous deux, euh, vous aviez quelque chose à faire, non?
Revelations in Fall#061.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#062.src: We did... uh, if y- you're sure, Sui. We'll see you l- la- later?
Revelations in Fall#062.dst: Oui... euh, si t- tu es sûre, Sui. On se voit p- p- plus tard?
Revelations in Fall#062.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#063.src: Y... yes. Um, good... good luck!
Revelations in Fall#063.dst: O... oui. Euh, bonne... bonne chance!
Revelations in Fall#063.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#064.src: ...okay. Well, {u}, the re- reason we came here... from up h- he- from up here, we have good access to the r- roof- rooftops.
Revelations in Fall#064.dst: ...bon. Alors, {u}, si on est v- venus ici... d'ici h- ha- d'ici en haut, on accède facilement aux t- toi- toits.
Revelations in Fall#064.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#065.src: I w- w- I want to see if we can ge- get over the wall. If we st- stick to the roofs, we should be able to av- avoid suspicion...
Revelations in Fall#065.dst: Je v- v- je veux voir si on p- peut passer la muraille. Si on r- reste sur les toits, on devrait év- éviter les soupçons...
Revelations in Fall#065.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#067.src: Follow Zeph to the tree branch at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Revelations in Fall#067.dst: Suivez Zeph jusqu'à la branche d'arbre en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Revelations in Fall#068.src: Ah, Sui! What a pleasure to see you as always!
Revelations in Fall#068.dst: Ah, Sui! Quel plaisir de te voir, comme toujours!
Revelations in Fall#068.speaker: Red Fox Owner

Revelations in Fall#069.src: Hi, Chen... is, um, business going well?
Revelations in Fall#069.dst: Bonjour, Chen... les affaires, euh, marchent bien?
Revelations in Fall#069.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#070.src: Hum, as well as one can hope, I would say! The Festival does always bring a rush of customers. So, should I prepare the usual for you?
Revelations in Fall#070.dst: Hum, aussi bien qu'on peut l'espérer, je dirais! Le Festival amène toujours une foule de clients. Alors, je te prépare comme d'habitude?
Revelations in Fall#070.speaker: Red Fox Owner

Revelations in Fall#071.src: Oh. Um... that's very kind of you, but, no, not today. Thank you.
Revelations in Fall#071.dst: Oh. Euh... c'est très gentil, mais non, pas aujourd'hui. Merci.
Revelations in Fall#071.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#072.src: Very well, very well. Well, since you're here, might I ask if you've had a thought about my job offer?
Revelations in Fall#072.dst: Très bien, très bien. Puisque tu es là, puis-je te demander si tu as réfléchi à mon offre d'emploi?
Revelations in Fall#072.speaker: Red Fox Owner

Revelations in Fall#073.src: You basically know our menu inside and out by this point, so I do truly think you'd be a great fit.
Revelations in Fall#073.dst: Tu connais notre carte par coeur maintenant, alors je pense vraiment que tu serais parfaite pour le poste.
Revelations in Fall#073.speaker: Red Fox Owner

Revelations in Fall#074.dst: C'est vrai... euh. A-à ce propos...
Revelations in Fall#074.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#075.src: Okay, so... just f- fo- follow the green trails !
Revelations in Fall#075.dst: Bon, alors... su- su- suis juste les traces vertes!
Revelations in Fall#075.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#076.src: If you g- get lost, meet me back here.
Revelations in Fall#076.dst: Si tu te p- perds, reviens ici.
Revelations in Fall#076.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#077.src: Travel across the roof tops of {p} starting from .

Revelations in Fall#079.src: Do you, uh, w- want to take a break?
Revelations in Fall#079.dst: Tu veux, euh, f- faire une pause?
Revelations in Fall#079.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#080.src: Alright, g- good luck! Just re- remember to follow the green trail.
Revelations in Fall#080.dst: D'accord, b- bonne chance! N'ou- n'oublie pas de suivre la trace verte.
Revelations in Fall#080.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#081.src: I- I'll follow you soon, I'm just w- war- warming up a bit first.
Revelations in Fall#081.dst: J- je te suis bientôt, je m- m'éch- m'échauffe un peu d'abord.
Revelations in Fall#081.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#083.src: Just re- return here when you're ready to st- start again.
Revelations in Fall#083.dst: Re- reviens ici quand tu veux re- recommencer.
Revelations in Fall#083.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#084.src: Ha, I- I guess you got here b- be- before me this time!
Revelations in Fall#084.dst: Ha, j- je crois que t'es arrivé a- av- avant moi cette fois!
Revelations in Fall#084.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#086.dst: Bon... s- sautons de l'autre côté.
Revelations in Fall#086.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#087.src: Aah! I... I... th- that was... c- cl- close.
Revelations in Fall#087.dst: Aah! Je... je... c- c'était... m- mo- moins une.
Revelations in Fall#087.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#088.src: That was... th- that was m- magic, wasn't it...? It was l- li- it was like my whole body was... w- was en- engulfed by a, a g- ge- gentle breeze...
Revelations in Fall#088.dst: C'était... c- c'était de la m- magie, non...? C'était c- co- c'était comme si tout mon corps... é- était en- enveloppé par une, une b- br- brise douce...
Revelations in Fall#088.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#089.src: I... ha. Th- that was- e- e- exhilarating, but... b- but... Th- there- there's no way we c- ca- we can get across these r- ro- rooftops... one c- cl- one close call is enough f- for me.
Revelations in Fall#089.dst: Je... ha. C- c'était- e- e- exaltant, mais... m- mais... I- il n'y a- il n'y a pas moyen qu'on t- tra- qu'on traverse ces t- toi- ces toits... une f- fr- une frayeur me suffit.
Revelations in Fall#089.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#090.src: Ugh... l- let's just... get back to the R- Red Fox...
Revelations in Fall#090.dst: Pff... r- retournons juste... au R- Renard Roux...
Revelations in Fall#090.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#091.src: Return to The Red Fox and talk to Zeph at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Revelations in Fall#091.dst: Retournez au Renard Roux et parlez à Zeph en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Revelations in Fall#092.src: I just... I- I- I don't like it. I don't like that S- Syn- Syndra's putting herself in- in danger like that!
Revelations in Fall#092.dst: C'est juste que... j- j- je n'aime pas ça. Je n'aime pas que S- Syn- Syndra se mette en- en danger comme ça!
Revelations in Fall#092.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#093.src: I... I owe her a lot. If it weren't for her, I- I- I'd still be st- stuck on the... the st- str- streets. It's thanks to her that I'm still... here.
Revelations in Fall#093.dst: Je... je lui dois beaucoup. Sans elle, j- j- je serais encore c- coincé dans... dans la r- ru- rue. C'est grâce à elle que je suis encore... là.
Revelations in Fall#093.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#095.src: Yeah... I, uh, grew up in a- a small village. S- someone was accused of being c- cursed, and... my people refused to h- ha- hand them over without a- a- wi- without a fight.
Revelations in Fall#095.dst: Ouais... j'ai, euh, grandi dans un- un petit village. Q- quelqu'un a été accusé d'être m- maudit, et... les miens ont refusé de le l- li- livrer sans s- s- sans- sans se battre.
Revelations in Fall#095.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#096.src: ...actually, wh- where is she? I th- thought she'd wait for us before...
Revelations in Fall#096.dst: ...au fait, o- où est-elle? Je c- croyais qu'elle nous attendrait avant de...
Revelations in Fall#096.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#097.src: Ah, Zeph, is that you I hear?
Revelations in Fall#097.dst: Ah, Zeph, c'est toi que j'entends?
Revelations in Fall#097.speaker: Red Fox Owner

Revelations in Fall#098.src: Oh, h- hey Chen. I need to get going, but have you seen Sui? We were g- go- going to meet up here.
Revelations in Fall#098.dst: Oh, s- salut Chen. Je dois y aller, mais tu as vu Sui? On d- de- devait se retrouver ici.
Revelations in Fall#098.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#099.src: Yes, Sui... she left not long ago. The poor girl, clearly something is weighing on her...
Revelations in Fall#099.dst: Oui, Sui... elle est partie il y a peu. La pauvre petite, quelque chose lui pèse, c'est évident...
Revelations in Fall#099.speaker: Red Fox Owner

Revelations in Fall#100.src: I believe she would have gone to the pond to the southeast... that is where she usually goes when she needs some air.
Revelations in Fall#100.dst: Je crois qu'elle est allée à l'étang au sud-est... c'est là qu'elle va d'habitude quand elle a besoin d'air.
Revelations in Fall#100.speaker: Red Fox Owner

Revelations in Fall#101.src: Oh, I s- see. Th- thank you for the help!
Revelations in Fall#101.dst: Oh, j- je vois. M- merci pour ton aide!
Revelations in Fall#101.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#102.src: Of course, anything for you children. Stop by again soon, would you? I'll make you all the family platter, on the house.
Revelations in Fall#102.dst: Bien sûr, tout pour vous, les enfants. Repassez vite, d'accord? Je vous ferai le plateau familial, offert par la maison.
Revelations in Fall#102.speaker: Red Fox Owner

Revelations in Fall#103.src: I... y- yeah, we... we will! Thanks for the off- offer.
Revelations in Fall#103.dst: Je... o- oui, on... on viendra! Merci pour l'in- invitation.
Revelations in Fall#103.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#104.src: {u}, can I ask you a f- fa- favour?
Revelations in Fall#104.dst: {u}, je peux te demander un s- se- service?
Revelations in Fall#104.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#105.src: Could you ch- check on Sui for me, p- please? I... I don't know h- how to help her, right now...
Revelations in Fall#105.dst: Tu pourrais aller v- voir comment va Sui, s'il te p- plaît? Je... je ne sais pas c- comment l'aider, là...
Revelations in Fall#105.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#106.src: S- some- something's on her mind, but... b- but she won't tell me about it. I've tr- tried asking, but...
Revelations in Fall#106.dst: Q- quel- quelque chose la tracasse, mais... m- mais elle ne veut pas m'en parler. J'ai es- essayé de lui demander, mais...
Revelations in Fall#106.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#107.src: ...but if you ask, ma- maybe she'll tell you? I- I don't know. It's worth a try, at- at least, r- r- right?
Revelations in Fall#107.dst: ...mais si c'est toi, p- peut-être qu'elle te le dira? J- je sais pas. Ça vaut le coup d'essayer, au- au moins, n- n- non?
Revelations in Fall#107.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#109.src: Th- thanks, {u}. Chen said she w- was at the pond to the southeast.
Revelations in Fall#109.dst: M- merci, {u}. Chen a dit qu'elle é- était à l'étang au sud-est.
Revelations in Fall#109.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#110.src: Meet up with Sui near the pond at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Revelations in Fall#110.dst: Retrouvez Sui près de l'étang en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Revelations in Fall#111.src: O-oh, {u}! I didn't... um, expect to see you here.
Revelations in Fall#111.dst: O-oh, {u}! Je ne... euh, m'attendais pas à te voir ici.
Revelations in Fall#111.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#113.src: Oh... right. I just... needed some air. It's, hah, kind of a lot. L-leaving Auburn, I mean! I've never... known anywhere else.
Revelations in Fall#113.dst: Oh... oui. J'avais juste... besoin d'air. C'est, ha, beaucoup d'un coup. Q-quitter Auburn, je veux dire! Je n'ai jamais... connu d'autre endroit.
Revelations in Fall#113.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#114.src: Can I... tell you something? I was... I wanted to talk to you, earlier, but, um, I... I couldn't build up the courage.
Revelations in Fall#114.dst: Je peux... te dire quelque chose? Je voulais... te parler, tout à l'heure, mais, euh, je... je n'ai pas trouvé le courage.
Revelations in Fall#114.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#115.src: S-sorry, I should just... go for it. It- it might be easier if I just, show you, hah...
Revelations in Fall#115.dst: P-pardon, je devrais juste... me lancer. Ce- ce serait peut-être plus simple de te montrer, ha...
Revelations in Fall#115.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#116.src: You're the first, um, cursed one I've ever... seen. And- and everyone being so kind, about, all of it...
Revelations in Fall#116.dst: Tu es le premier, euh, Maudit que j'aie jamais... vu. Et- et tout le monde est si gentil, avec, tout ça...
Revelations in Fall#116.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#117.src: And, I thought, maybe... maybe you could... help. Me. W-with figuring it all out.
Revelations in Fall#117.dst: Et je me suis dit que, peut-être... peut-être que tu pourrais... m'aider. Moi. A- à comprendre tout ça.
Revelations in Fall#117.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#118.src: But... I don't use, um, a focus. To... to control water. S-so, that means I'm, one of the... d-dangerous ones. That's... th-that's what Mora said, um, earlier.
Revelations in Fall#118.dst: Mais... je n'utilise pas, euh, de focaliseur. Pour... pour contrôler l'eau. D-donc je suis, une des... d-dangereuses. C'est... c-c'est ce qu'a dit Mora, euh, tout à l'heure.
Revelations in Fall#118.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#120.dst: T-tu- tu ne peux pas le savoir!
Revelations in Fall#120.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#122.src: Oh... g-good. That's- that's good. I'm glad.
Revelations in Fall#122.dst: Oh... t-tant mieux. C'est- c'est bien. Je suis contente.
Revelations in Fall#122.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#123.src: Oh... that's, ha, a big thing to do for someone. B-breaking into a province? I can't imagine, um, doing something like that...
Revelations in Fall#123.dst: Oh... c'est, ha, beaucoup faire pour quelqu'un. S-s'introduire dans une province? Je ne m'imagine pas, euh, faire une chose pareille...
Revelations in Fall#123.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#124.src: I'm just... scared. I'm scared that- that if I try to use it, then, I'll, h-hurt someone...
Revelations in Fall#124.dst: J'ai juste... peur. J'ai peur que- que si j'essaie de m'en servir, je, b-blesse quelqu'un...
Revelations in Fall#124.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#125.src: I'm... not very brave, haha. I didn't, really, join the resistance because... because I wanted to stand up against the crown!
Revelations in Fall#125.dst: Je ne suis... pas très courageuse, haha. Je n'ai pas, vraiment, rejoint la résistance parce que... parce que je voulais m'opposer à la Couronne!
Revelations in Fall#125.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#126.src: Something like that, it feels... impossible.
Revelations in Fall#126.dst: Une chose pareille, ça me semble... impossible.
Revelations in Fall#126.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#127.src: ... I'm only here because I followed Mora. He's the brave one! N-not- not me. I just, ha, had nowhere else to go.
Revelations in Fall#127.dst: ... Je ne suis là que parce que j'ai suivi Mora. C'est lui, le courageux! P-pas- pas moi. Je n'avais juste, ha, nulle part où aller.
Revelations in Fall#127.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#128.src: And- and everyone else is so, excited about m-ma-magic! Even, um, Mora. And here I am, too afraid to- to even try!
Revelations in Fall#128.dst: Et- et tous les autres sont si, emballés par la m-ma-magie! Même, euh, Mora. Et moi, j'ai trop peur pour- pour même essayer!
Revelations in Fall#128.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#129.dst: Tu n'es pas obligée de venir.

Revelations in Fall#130.src: Yeah, but... it- it wouldn't feel, um, right. If the rest of my family is going, then, ha, how could I not go with them?
Revelations in Fall#130.dst: Oui, mais... ça- ça ne me semblerait pas, euh, juste. Si le reste de ma famille part, alors, ha, comment je pourrais ne pas les suivre?
Revelations in Fall#130.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#131.src: What if... something happened to them- to you - and, and, and- and I wasn't, there? I'd... I'd never f-forgive myself!
Revelations in Fall#131.dst: Et si... il leur arrivait quelque chose- à toi aussi - et, et, et- et que je n'étais pas, là? Je... je ne me le p-pardonnerais jamais!
Revelations in Fall#131.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#132.src: So... s-so, even if I'm scared... I can't stay behind.
Revelations in Fall#132.dst: Alors... a-alors, même si j'ai peur... je ne peux pas rester en arrière.
Revelations in Fall#132.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#133.src: ...I'm, um, not much of a fighter. But I'm still good with m-medicine, and healing. So... I can help.
Revelations in Fall#133.dst: ...je ne suis, euh, pas une grande combattante. Mais je reste douée en m-médecine, et en soins. Alors... je peux aider.
Revelations in Fall#133.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#134.src: Let's... get back home. I should tell Zeph I'm alright.
Revelations in Fall#134.dst: Rentrons... à la maison. Je devrais dire à Zeph que je vais bien.
Revelations in Fall#134.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#135.src: Return to the Leaves in the Wind at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Revelations in Fall#135.dst: Retournez à Feuilles au vent en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Revelations in Fall#136.src: Thank you for listening to me.
Revelations in Fall#136.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#137.src: I... I want to help. I'm just... scared.
Revelations in Fall#137.dst: Je... je veux aider. J'ai juste... peur.
Revelations in Fall#137.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#138.src: Hrmm... ah, {u}, just the leaf I was looking to find!
Revelations in Fall#138.dst: Hrmm... ah, {u}, justement la feuille que je cherchais!
Revelations in Fall#138.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#139.src: I am nearly finished with preparations for our expedition. Supplies packed, goodbyes said, and so on and so forth.
Revelations in Fall#139.dst: J'ai presque terminé les préparatifs de notre expédition. Provisions emballées, adieux faits, et ainsi de suite.
Revelations in Fall#139.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#140.src: There is... one last thing, however. If I may ask you for a favor?
Revelations in Fall#140.dst: Il reste... une dernière chose, toutefois. Puis-je te demander une faveur?
Revelations in Fall#140.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#141.src: Excellent! I thank you for your time.
Revelations in Fall#141.dst: Excellent! Je te remercie de ton temps.
Revelations in Fall#141.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#142.src: ...ah, a busy day, I take it? I promise it will be quick, if you would hear me out.
Revelations in Fall#142.dst: ...ah, une journée chargée, je présume? Je promets que ce sera rapide, si tu veux bien m'écouter.
Revelations in Fall#142.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#143.src: I had mentioned previously, your words on magic had resonated with me! I have been taking some time to practice, with the aid of cursory knowledge of military blessings.
Revelations in Fall#143.dst: Je te l'ai déjà dit, tes paroles sur la magie m'ont touché! J'ai pris le temps de m'exercer, avec l'aide de vagues notions sur les bénédictions militaires.
Revelations in Fall#143.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#144.src: But such training will do me little good in a true combat scenario. So, in the interest of improvement, I would ask for a sparring match against you!
Revelations in Fall#144.dst: Mais un tel entraînement ne me servira guère dans un vrai combat. Alors, dans un souci de progrès, je te demande un duel d'entraînement!
Revelations in Fall#144.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#145.src: It will help me to spot and shore up my weaknesses. Perhaps it will do the same for you!
Revelations in Fall#145.dst: Il m'aidera à repérer et à corriger mes faiblesses. Peut-être en fera-t-il autant pour toi!
Revelations in Fall#145.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#146.src: Come, follow me to our sparring arena!
Revelations in Fall#146.dst: Viens, suis-moi jusqu'à notre arène d'entraînement!
Revelations in Fall#146.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#149.src: Oof... you are very talented, I must say!
Revelations in Fall#149.dst: Ouf... tu as beaucoup de talent, je dois dire!
Revelations in Fall#149.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#150.src: No wonder miss Syndra is so invested in you, having battled you herself!
Revelations in Fall#150.dst: Pas étonnant que madame Syndra mise autant sur toi, elle qui t'a affronté en personne!
Revelations in Fall#150.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#151.src: Now, tell me, how did I perform?
Revelations in Fall#151.dst: Alors, dis-moi, comment m'en suis-je sorti?
Revelations in Fall#151.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#153.src: Really! In the moment, it did not feel like I stood much of a chance, but I suppose I am still learning to wield it!
Revelations in Fall#153.dst: Vraiment! Sur le moment, je n'avais pas l'impression d'avoir beaucoup de chances, mais je suppose que j'apprends encore à la manier!
Revelations in Fall#153.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#154.src: It is odd, though. I have only learned of it recently, yet it fels as though the magic has been with me all along! It is like... muscle memory, I suppose? Much to think about.
Revelations in Fall#154.dst: C'est curieux, pourtant. Je ne l'ai découverte que récemment, mais j'ai l'impression que la magie a toujours été en moi! C'est comme... une mémoire musculaire, peut-être? Voilà qui donne à réfléchir.
Revelations in Fall#154.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#155.src: Ha! No need to sugarcoat it. I have always specialized in heavy attacks, so I struggle against swift opponents. Rarely have I managed to best Zeph in a spar!
Revelations in Fall#155.dst: Ha! Inutile d'enrober les choses. Je me suis toujours spécialisé dans les attaques lourdes, alors j'ai du mal face aux adversaires rapides. J'ai rarement battu Zeph à l'entraînement!
Revelations in Fall#155.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#156.src: Perhaps therein lies the value of this magic... finding methods to raise area of effect, or slow targets down? Much to think about.
Revelations in Fall#156.dst: C'est peut-être là tout l'intérêt de cette magie... trouver comment élargir la zone d'effet, ou ralentir les cibles? Voilà qui donne à réfléchir.
Revelations in Fall#156.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#158.src: An excellent question, though I have no true answers. Perhaps some of what I had learned from military sources has stuck with me?
Revelations in Fall#158.dst: Excellente question, mais je n'ai pas de vraie réponse. Peut-être qu'une partie de ce que j'ai appris de sources militaires m'est restée?
Revelations in Fall#158.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#159.src: I do trust it will come to Zeph with time. He is persistent! That trait will serve him well for these purposes.
Revelations in Fall#159.dst: Je suis sûr que ça viendra à Zeph avec le temps. Il est persévérant! Ce trait lui sera très utile pour cela.
Revelations in Fall#159.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#160.src: Hey, Mora! Have you seen- oh, there you are. I've been looking for you.
Revelations in Fall#160.dst: Hé, Mora! Tu n'aurais pas vu- ah, te voilà. Je te cherchais.
Revelations in Fall#160.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#161.src: I had a friend... he was also from Fruma, and he was "cursed." And he was also struggling with that label, like you.
Revelations in Fall#161.dst: J'avais un ami... lui aussi venait de Fruma, et il était "maudit". Et lui aussi avait du mal avec cette étiquette, comme toi.

Revelations in Fall#162.src: But he found ways to make peace with it. He used his abilities to strengthen himself and his allies. He made a difference.
Revelations in Fall#162.dst: Mais il a trouvé le moyen de l'accepter. Il a utilisé ses capacités pour se renforcer, lui et ses alliés. Il a changé les choses.

Revelations in Fall#163.src: Alright, {u}, come with me. We are SORTING through our problems before we leave.
Revelations in Fall#163.dst: Bon, {u}, viens avec moi. On va RÉGLER nos problèmes avant de partir.
Revelations in Fall#163.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#164.src: Come on, come on! To the giant tree stump, I don't have all day!
Revelations in Fall#164.dst: Allez, allez! Direction la souche géante, j'ai pas toute la journée!
Revelations in Fall#164.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#165.src: ... Ah. Oh dear. She appears to be in a mood today! I suppose that would make sense, given...
Revelations in Fall#165.dst: ... Ah. Oh là là. Elle semble de mauvaise humeur aujourd'hui! Ce qui se comprendrait, vu que...
Revelations in Fall#165.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#166.src: Hmm, how should I put it...? Ah, nevermind. You'd best follow her to the tree, see what she wants.
Revelations in Fall#166.dst: Hmm, comment dire...? Ah, laisse tomber. Tu ferais mieux de la suivre jusqu'à l'arbre, pour voir ce qu'elle veut.
Revelations in Fall#166.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#167.src: Keep an eye on her for me, would you? Make sure she gets home safely.
Revelations in Fall#167.dst: Garde un oeil sur elle pour moi, veux-tu? Veille à ce qu'elle rentre saine et sauve.
Revelations in Fall#167.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#168.src: Find Rex at the old tree stump at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Revelations in Fall#168.dst: Retrouvez Rex près de la vieille souche en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Revelations in Fall#169.src: Keep an eye on Rex, would you? I haven't seen her this worked up in a while...
Revelations in Fall#169.dst: Garde un oeil sur Rex, veux-tu? Je ne l'avais pas vue aussi remontée depuis longtemps...
Revelations in Fall#169.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#170.src: Good, you came. Took you long enough!
Revelations in Fall#170.dst: Bien, te voilà. Il était temps!
Revelations in Fall#170.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#171.src: So, here's the deal! You are a problem.
Revelations in Fall#171.dst: Bon, voilà le topo! Tu es un problème.
Revelations in Fall#171.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#172.src: Sure, you've proven yourself a hundred times over! Over and over and over again, you've shown you're on our side.
Revelations in Fall#172.dst: Bien sûr, tu as fait tes preuves cent fois! Encore et encore et encore, tu as montré que tu étais de notre côté.
Revelations in Fall#172.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#173.src: And that's great! That's great and all! But. But but but but but! You're still. From. Wynn.
Revelations in Fall#173.dst: Et c'est génial! Génial et tout ce que tu veux! Mais. Mais mais mais mais mais! Tu es toujours. De. Wynn.
Revelations in Fall#173.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#174.src: Or... originally from Fruma, whatever. That's actually the problem! If you were just from Wynn, maybe it wouldn't be so bad!
Revelations in Fall#174.dst: Ou... originaire de Fruma, peu importe. C'est justement ça, le problème! Si tu venais juste de Wynn, ce serait peut-être pas si grave!
Revelations in Fall#174.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#175.src: There's oh so many people from Fruma who were shipped off to Wynn! They really like sending off the problem children whenever they can't deal with them anymore.
Revelations in Fall#175.dst: Il y a tellement de gens de Fruma qu'on a expédiés à Wynn! Ils adorent se débarrasser des enfants à problèmes dès qu'ils ne savent plus quoi en faire.
Revelations in Fall#175.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#176.src: So I get it! I do! It makes sense! But still... still, why, why... why does it get to be YOU here, and not- not...!
Revelations in Fall#176.dst: Alors je comprends! Vraiment! C'est logique! Mais quand même... pourquoi, pourquoi... pourquoi c'est TOI qui es là, et pas- pas...!
Revelations in Fall#176.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#177.src: Oh, don't look at me like that.
Revelations in Fall#177.dst: Oh, me regarde pas comme ça.
Revelations in Fall#177.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#178.src: So I had a brother, right? And sure, he was an idiot sometimes, but- but he was the only one there who really understood me.
Revelations in Fall#178.dst: J'avais un frère, d'accord? Et oui, c'était parfois un idiot, mais- mais c'était le seul là-bas à vraiment me comprendre.
Revelations in Fall#178.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#179.src: He's the one who carved my bow for me. He heard I was interested in archery, so he... when everyone else told me to just focus on schoolwork, he helped me learn.
Revelations in Fall#179.dst: C'est lui qui m'a taillé mon arc. Il avait appris que le tir à l'arc m'intéressait, alors il... quand les autres me disaient de me concentrer sur l'école, lui m'a aidée à apprendre.
Revelations in Fall#179.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#180.src: He really hated all the rules we had up there. So he liked to break them. A lot. And eventually, the crown got sick of it. Packed him up, sent him to the Roughworks.
Revelations in Fall#180.dst: Il détestait toutes les règles qu'on avait là-haut. Alors il aimait les enfreindre. Beaucoup. Et un jour, la Couronne en a eu marre. Ils l'ont emballé et expédié à Roughworks.
Revelations in Fall#180.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#181.src: The worst part was, our parents agreed to it! Said it'd be good for him, to get some real hard work!
Revelations in Fall#181.dst: Le pire, c'est que nos parents étaient d'accord! Ils disaient qu'un vrai travail bien dur lui ferait du bien!
Revelations in Fall#181.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#182.src: I never liked it there anyway. It took me a while to build up the courage, but eventually I stole some of our money and bought a ticket to take me there.
Revelations in Fall#182.dst: De toute façon, j'ai jamais aimé cet endroit. Il m'a fallu du temps pour trouver le courage, mais j'ai fini par voler un peu de notre argent et acheter un billet pour là-bas.
Revelations in Fall#182.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#183.src: I didn't pack a whole lot. I guess I expected to find him and live with him! Stupid. Should've thought ahead more.
Revelations in Fall#183.dst: J'avais pas pris grand-chose. Je pensais sûrement le retrouver et vivre avec lui! Idiote. J'aurais dû mieux réfléchir.
Revelations in Fall#183.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#184.src: He wasn't there, obviously. Heard from some of his friends that he kept being stupid over there. Got caught by the crown, and they decided to stop giving him second chances.
Revelations in Fall#184.dst: Il n'était pas là, évidemment. Des amis à lui m'ont dit qu'il avait continué ses bêtises là-bas. La Couronne l'a attrapé, et a décidé d'arrêter de lui donner des secondes chances.
Revelations in Fall#184.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#185.src: So, he's gone! He promised he'd see me again someday, and- and of course he didn't follow through. I guess I wasn't important enough to remember.
Revelations in Fall#185.dst: Alors, il est parti! Il m'avait promis qu'on se reverrait un jour, et- et bien sûr, il a pas tenu parole. Faut croire que je comptais pas assez pour qu'il s'en souvienne.
Revelations in Fall#185.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#186.src: Yes, I know. I just... I guess I just hoped I'd be an exception.
Revelations in Fall#186.dst: Oui, je sais. C'est juste que... j'espérais sans doute être l'exception.
Revelations in Fall#186.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#187.src: I haven't been very fair to you, have I? It's not your fault you're here and he isn't.
Revelations in Fall#187.dst: J'ai pas été très juste avec toi, hein? C'est pas ta faute si tu es là et pas lui.
Revelations in Fall#187.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#188.src: So... sorry. For all of that.
Revelations in Fall#188.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#189.src: Give me some time, would you? I need to... I don't know. I just need some space.
Revelations in Fall#189.dst: Laisse-moi un peu de temps, tu veux? J'ai besoin de... je sais pas. J'ai juste besoin d'espace.
Revelations in Fall#189.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#190.dst: Ha! Ça lui ressemble bien, hein...
Revelations in Fall#190.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#191.src: Okay. I... won't take too long. Nobody ever comes here, anyway.
Revelations in Fall#191.dst: D'accord. Je... vais pas traîner. De toute façon, personne vient jamais ici.
Revelations in Fall#191.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#192.src: Return to the camp and finish packing up at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Revelations in Fall#192.dst: Retournez au camp et finissez vos bagages en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Revelations in Fall#194.src: I just hope he's still out there, somewhere...
Revelations in Fall#194.dst: J'espère juste qu'il est toujours quelque part, là-dehors...
Revelations in Fall#194.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#195.src: Th- there you are! We, uh, got worried s- some- something bad might've happened.
Revelations in Fall#195.dst: Te- te voilà! On s'est, euh, inquiétés qu'il soit a- ar- arrivé quelque chose de grave.
Revelations in Fall#195.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#196.src: I... I mean... th- they got worried.
Revelations in Fall#196.dst: Je... enfin... e- eux se sont inquiétés.
Revelations in Fall#196.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#198.src: We were just talking. Gods, you guys and your overeager imaginations...
Revelations in Fall#198.dst: On faisait que parler. Par les dieux, vous et votre imagination débordante...
Revelations in Fall#198.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#200.src: I am afraid not. We have heard nothing since the meeting this morning.
Revelations in Fall#200.dst: Je crains que non. Nous n'avons rien entendu depuis la réunion de ce matin.
Revelations in Fall#200.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#201.dst: Euh... alors, on devrait... défaire nos bagages?
Revelations in Fall#201.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#202.src: Let us just continue to place our trust in Syndra, as we have done many times before! She can handle herself.
Revelations in Fall#202.dst: Continuons simplement à faire confiance à Syndra, comme nous l'avons fait tant de fois! Elle sait se débrouiller.
Revelations in Fall#202.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#203.src: Ugh! I knew t- tr- trusting the Sovereign w- was a mistake! We n- n- need to go-
Revelations in Fall#203.dst: Pff! Je savais que f- fa- faire confiance au Souverain é- était une erreur! Il f- f- faut y aller-
Revelations in Fall#203.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#204.src: Excuse me- the Sovereign? What do you mean the S-
Revelations in Fall#204.dst: Pardon- le Souverain? Comment ça, le S-
Revelations in Fall#204.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#206.src: Sigh... I'm just a little too late, I see.
Revelations in Fall#206.dst: Soupir... J'arrive un peu trop tard, à ce que je vois.
Revelations in Fall#206.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#207.src: Well, since it's out in the open, I might as well explain myself. Firstly, I owe you all an apology for this.
Revelations in Fall#207.dst: Bon, puisque c'est sorti, autant m'expliquer. D'abord, je vous dois des excuses à tous.
Revelations in Fall#207.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#209.src: Mora, it's alright. I was going to reveal this secret anyway.
Revelations in Fall#209.dst: Mora, ça va. J'allais révéler ce secret de toute façon.
Revelations in Fall#209.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#210.src: The contact I mentioned earlier today - it's the Sovereign Zhiraok.
Revelations in Fall#210.dst: Le contact dont je vous ai parlé ce matin - c'est le Souverain Zhiraok.
Revelations in Fall#210.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#212.src: What?! How long have you been- wait, Mora, you knew?
Revelations in Fall#212.dst: Quoi?! Depuis quand tu- attends, Mora, tu étais au courant?
Revelations in Fall#212.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#213.src: It was a secret kept out of necessity. As for how long... let's say a while, and leave it at that. But we're leaving the {p}, so I see no need to keep it hidden anymore.
Revelations in Fall#213.dst: C'était un secret gardé par nécessité. Quant à depuis quand... disons un moment, et restons-en là. Mais nous quittons {p}, alors je ne vois plus de raison de le cacher.
Revelations in Fall#213.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#214.src: I know you all worry about me... and I did not want to add another variable to stress over today. I apologize.
Revelations in Fall#214.dst: Je sais que vous vous inquiétez tous pour moi... et je ne voulais pas vous ajouter une variable de plus aujourd'hui. Pardon.
Revelations in Fall#214.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#216.src: Yes, I have them. Zhiraok provided me with enough for all of us. We'll need to move fast, though - I want to cross into the Roughworks before he suspects what's going on.
Revelations in Fall#216.dst: Oui, je les ai. Zhiraok m'en a fourni assez pour nous tous. Mais il faudra faire vite - je veux passer à Roughworks avant qu'il se doute de quoi que ce soit.
Revelations in Fall#216.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#217.src: ...s- so you're safe? It all w- went fine?
Revelations in Fall#217.dst: ...d- donc tu es saine et sauve? Tout s'est b- bien passé?
Revelations in Fall#217.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#218.src: Yes, Zeph, I am safe. Are you all packed? Crossing the border will take some time, so we need to start going to {p} now.
Revelations in Fall#218.dst: Oui, Zeph, je suis saine et sauve. Vos bagages sont prêts? Passer la frontière prendra du temps, il faut partir pour {p} maintenant.
Revelations in Fall#218.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#219.src: Come on, let's hurry. Let us leave this chapter behind.
Revelations in Fall#219.dst: Allez, dépêchons-nous. Laissons ce chapitre derrière nous.
Revelations in Fall#219.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#220.src: Walk through the gate to the Roughworks at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] in {p}.
Revelations in Fall#220.dst: Passez la porte vers Roughworks en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}], à {p}.

Revelations in Fall#221.src: I-I a-am ready for this. I have to be.
Revelations in Fall#221.dst: J-je s-suis prêt. Il le faut.
Revelations in Fall#221.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#222.src: I guess this is really happening...
Revelations in Fall#222.dst: On dirait que ça arrive vraiment...
Revelations in Fall#222.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#223.src: Let's meet up at the gate to the Roughworks and walk through together!
Revelations in Fall#223.dst: Retrouvons-nous à la porte de Roughworks et passons-la ensemble!
Revelations in Fall#223.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#224.src: Oh... there you are. The, um, line was really long when we got here, so, we... started queuing.
Revelations in Fall#224.dst: Oh... te voilà. La, euh, file était vraiment longue quand on est arrivés, alors on... s'est mis à faire la queue.
Revelations in Fall#224.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#225.src: Everything's... fine, so far. I think. I... hope.
Revelations in Fall#225.dst: Tout va... bien, pour l'instant. Je crois. J'espère... en tout cas.
Revelations in Fall#225.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#229.src: All good. Keep it moving. NEXT!
Revelations in Fall#229.speaker: Passport Officer

Revelations in Fall#234.src: We're through. That went... smoothly enough.
Revelations in Fall#234.dst: On est passés. Ça s'est... plutôt bien déroulé.
Revelations in Fall#234.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#238.src: Enough of that, children. Miss Syndra, we've reached the Roughworks, yes?
Revelations in Fall#238.dst: Assez, les enfants. Madame Syndra, nous sommes bien à Roughworks, n'est-ce pas?
Revelations in Fall#238.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#239.src: We have. We'll follow the plan - regroup outside {p}, the city in the region. We need to move quickly, I don't know how much time we have before-
Revelations in Fall#239.dst: Oui. On suit le plan - on se regroupe devant {p}, la ville de la région. Il faut faire vite, j'ignore combien de temps nous avons avant-
Revelations in Fall#239.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#240.src: Zero, Syndra. You've got zero time.
Revelations in Fall#240.dst: Zéro, Syndra. Il te reste zéro temps.
Revelations in Fall#240.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#241.src: ... Sovereign. Fast and efficient as always, I see.
Revelations in Fall#241.dst: ... Souverain. Rapide et efficace, comme toujours.
Revelations in Fall#241.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#242.src: Naturally. You completely miscalculated, thinking you could sneak by like this. An unwanted variable isn't an unexpected one.
Revelations in Fall#242.dst: Évidemment. Tu as complètement mal calculé en pensant pouvoir te faufiler ainsi. Une variable indésirable n'est pas une variable inattendue.
Revelations in Fall#242.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#243.src: It was worth a shot, even if unlikely.
Revelations in Fall#243.dst: Ça valait le coup d'essayer, même si c'était improbable.
Revelations in Fall#243.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#244.src: What garbage. Translating yourself into the Roughworks completely nulls the crown's pact... As if you wouldn't be spotted.
Revelations in Fall#244.dst: Quelle ineptie. Faire ta translation jusqu'à Roughworks annule purement le pacte de la Couronne... Comme si on n'allait pas te repérer.
Revelations in Fall#244.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#245.src: I'm the one who really miscalculated though! Your angle was so obvious, but I just kept overlooking it. Kept trusting you. Kept hoping you'd settle, you'd terminate this sequence.
Revelations in Fall#245.dst: Mais c'est moi qui ai vraiment mal calculé! Ton angle était si évident, et je l'ai sans cesse négligé. Je te faisais confiance. J'espérais que tu te stabiliserais, que tu clorais cette suite.
Revelations in Fall#245.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#246.src: And here you are...associating with a mass murderer! The cursed that caused the Torann massacre!! What kind of lowest-order logic is this?! What were you THINKING?!
Revelations in Fall#246.dst: Et te voilà... à fréquenter un meurtrier de masse! Le maudit responsable du massacre de Torann!! C'est quoi, cette logique du plus bas degré?! Qu'est-ce qui t'est PASSÉ par la tête?!
Revelations in Fall#246.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#247.src: Isn't it obvious, Sovereign? I want Her Majesty dethroned. I want her empire to crumble.
Revelations in Fall#247.dst: N'est-ce pas évident, Souverain? Je veux voir Sa Majesté détrônée. Je veux que son empire s'effondre.
Revelations in Fall#247.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#248.src: Your job was to infiltrate, not sum to the resistance!! Since when did you switch to the other side of the equation?! You're subtracting your only chance, you're- You're wasting everything I've done for you!
Revelations in Fall#248.dst: Ton travail, c'était d'infiltrer, pas de t'additionner à la résistance!! Depuis quand tu es passée de l'autre côté de l'équation?! Tu soustrais ta seule chance, tu- Tu gâches tout ce que j'ai fait pour toi!
Revelations in Fall#248.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#249.src: So after everything She did to me, you expected me to just go along with it?! To accept the scraps I was left with, to forgive and forget?!
Revelations in Fall#249.dst: Alors après tout ce qu'Elle m'a fait, tu t'attendais à ce que je suive le mouvement?! Que j'accepte les miettes qu'on m'a laissées, que je pardonne et oublie?!
Revelations in Fall#249.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#250.src: Maybe you were the fool all along, Zhiraok, for believing it.
Revelations in Fall#250.dst: Le vrai idiot, c'était peut-être toi depuis le début, Zhiraok, d'y avoir cru.
Revelations in Fall#250.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#251.src: ...so was it all imaginary? Nothing real? I cared about you, as a friend. A confidant. Did you? Or...was I just a convenient tool for you?
Revelations in Fall#251.dst: ...alors tout était imaginaire? Rien de réel? Je tenais à toi, en amie. En confidente. Et toi? Ou... n'étais-je qu'un outil commode pour toi?
Revelations in Fall#251.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#253.src: Does it...matter. ...ha. Does it matter!! Do you know how much weight you carried in my day to day operations? I wonder how much I carried in yours!!
Revelations in Fall#253.dst: Quelle... importance. ...ha. Quelle importance!! Tu sais quel poids tu avais dans mes opérations quotidiennes? Je me demande quel poids j'avais dans les tiennes!!
Revelations in Fall#253.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#254.src: It doesn't make me happy to do this. Your resistance is under arrest for the crime of conspiracy against the crown- and your cursed, slated for execution.
Revelations in Fall#254.dst: Ça ne me réjouit pas de faire ça. Ta résistance est en état d'arrestation pour conspiration contre la Couronne- et ton maudit, promis à l'exécution.
Revelations in Fall#254.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#255.src: I can still pull some strings, Syndra. Round this all out. I might be able to keep you as part of the remainder if you turn yourself in. We can still-
Revelations in Fall#255.dst: Je peux encore tirer quelques ficelles, Syndra. Arrondir tout ça. Je pourrais peut-être te compter dans le reste si tu te rends. On peut encore-
Revelations in Fall#255.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#256.src: We won't give in without a fight!
Revelations in Fall#256.dst: Nous ne céderons pas sans nous battre!
Revelations in Fall#256.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#257.src: ...why...do I even bother. A cursed compared to me...absolute trash. Let's get this over with.
Revelations in Fall#257.dst: ...pourquoi... je m'embête encore. Un maudit comparé à moi... un pur déchet. Finissons-en.
Revelations in Fall#257.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#260.src: S- Syndra, are- are y- you-
Revelations in Fall#260.dst: S- Syndra, est- est-ce que t- tu-
Revelations in Fall#260.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#263.src: Let's move. Everyone, remember the meeting point, just-
Revelations in Fall#263.dst: On y va. Tout le monde, rappelez-vous le point de rendez-vous, juste-
Revelations in Fall#263.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#264.src: Are we really glossing over you killing a Sovereign????
Revelations in Fall#264.dst: On va vraiment passer sous silence le fait que tu as tué un Souverain????
Revelations in Fall#264.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#265.src: Yes, Rex, because he won't stay down for long- that's why we need to move, now!
Revelations in Fall#265.dst: Oui, Rex, parce qu'il ne restera pas à terre longtemps- c'est pour ça qu'il faut bouger, maintenant!
Revelations in Fall#265.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#266.src: Split up, stay safe, don't get caught. We meet in three days- now, GO!
Revelations in Fall#266.dst: Dispersez-vous, prudence, ne vous faites pas prendre. Rendez-vous dans trois jours- FILEZ!
Revelations in Fall#266.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#267.src: Sovereign Zhiraok, sir! You have a visitor here!
Revelations in Fall#267.dst: Souverain Zhiraok, monsieur! Vous avez de la visite!
Revelations in Fall#267.speaker: Xao

Revelations in Fall#268.src: Send them in, and if you could process these files, please-and-thank-you? I need the inquisitor to weigh in on the problem.
Revelations in Fall#268.dst: Fais entrer, et si tu pouvais traiter ces dossiers, s'il-te-plaît-et-merci? J'ai besoin que l'Inquisiteur se prononce sur le problème.
Revelations in Fall#268.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#269.src: I have a finite value of time for this, so let's keep this short-
Revelations in Fall#269.dst: J'ai une valeur finie de temps à y consacrer, alors faisons court-
Revelations in Fall#269.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#270.src: Hello, Sovereign. Sorry to interrupt you during your working hours once again.
Revelations in Fall#270.dst: Bonjour, Souverain. Désolée de t'interrompre encore pendant tes heures de travail.
Revelations in Fall#270.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#271.src: I'll add it to the tally! Bringing the trouble straight to my office, too- You've got me nervous with the number of times it's happened recently.
Revelations in Fall#271.dst: Je l'ajouterai au décompte! Et en plus tu amènes les ennuis droit dans mon bureau- Le nombre de fois où c'est arrivé ces temps-ci me rend nerveux.
Revelations in Fall#271.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#272.src: Let's cut to the chase, then. Tell me what your angle- Ugh. What your request is.
Revelations in Fall#272.dst: Allons droit au but, alors. Dis-moi quel est ton angle- Pff. Quelle est ta requête.
Revelations in Fall#272.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#273.src: Don't hold it in, you'll get an ulcer. I'll make this quick- I need passage to the Roughworks. For myself and five others.
Revelations in Fall#273.dst: Ne garde pas ça pour toi, tu vas te faire un ulcère. Je serai brève- il me faut un passage pour Roughworks. Pour moi et cinq autres.
Revelations in Fall#273.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#274.src: ...you're really asking me to square the circle here. Why do you need to do this, go there? And so suddenly? Why?
Revelations in Fall#274.dst: ...tu me demandes vraiment la quadrature du cercle, là. Pourquoi as-tu besoin de faire ça, d'aller là-bas? Et si soudainement? Pourquoi?
Revelations in Fall#274.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#275.src: I... I need to find her. I don't know how much more time I'll have to try.
Revelations in Fall#275.dst: Je... je dois la retrouver. Je ne sais pas combien de temps il me reste pour essayer.
Revelations in Fall#275.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#276.src: I know, I know!! Quit being obtuse, you know the consequences if you break the mandate, for both of us!!
Revelations in Fall#276.dst: Je sais, je sais!! Arrête de faire l'obtuse, tu connais les conséquences si tu romps le mandat, pour nous deux!!
Revelations in Fall#276.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#278.src: ...Is that all I get? What about the other five?
Revelations in Fall#278.dst: ...C'est tout ce que j'obtiens? Et les cinq autres?
Revelations in Fall#278.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#279.dst: Je ne peux pas les abandonner.
Revelations in Fall#279.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#280.src: Of course. You and your strays. Why can't you just... There has to be another solution, if we- If you- I-
Revelations in Fall#280.dst: Évidemment. Toi et tes chiens errants. Pourquoi tu ne peux pas simplement... Il doit y avoir une autre solution, si on- Si tu- Je-
Revelations in Fall#280.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#281.src: ...why do I even bother. Fine. You want it so badly, fine!! You know what this will take. Just... Remember. Remember what I've done for you.
Revelations in Fall#281.dst: ...pourquoi je m'embête. Bon. Tu y tiens tant que ça? D'accord!! Tu sais ce que ça coûtera. Seulement... Souviens-toi. Souviens-toi de ce que j'ai fait pour toi.
Revelations in Fall#281.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#282.src: Thank you, Zhiraok. I won't let your kindness go to waste.
Revelations in Fall#282.dst: Merci, Zhiraok. Je ne laisserai pas ta bonté se perdre.
Revelations in Fall#282.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#283.src: Sovereign Zhiraok! Inquisitor Renn has some concerns-
Revelations in Fall#283.dst: Souverain Zhiraok! L'Inquisiteur Renn a quelques inquiétudes-
Revelations in Fall#283.speaker: Xao

Revelations in Fall#284.src: Xao, I need you to clear my schedule. There's a higher priority now, he can wait.
Revelations in Fall#284.dst: Xao, j'ai besoin que tu libères mon agenda. Il y a une priorité plus haute, il peut attendre.
Revelations in Fall#284.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#285.src: Oh! Um, of course! If you insist, sir!! Inquisitor Renn won't be happy, but your orders are top-
Revelations in Fall#285.dst: Oh! Euh, bien sûr! Si vous insistez, monsieur!! L'Inquisiteur Renn ne sera pas content, mais vos ordres sont prior-
Revelations in Fall#285.speaker: Xao

Revelations in Fall#286.src: No, you're right, I'm being irrational. You're always right. Clear everything but that, it's fine. I'll get back to it later. Unexpected variables, extenuating circumstances...
Revelations in Fall#286.dst: Non, tu as raison, je suis irrationnel. Tu as toujours raison. Libère tout sauf ça, ça ira. J'y reviendrai plus tard. Variables inattendues, circonstances atténuantes...
Revelations in Fall#286.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#287.src: Sov- ...Zhi-Zhi? Is everything okay? You...you look rattled, was it something she said? Should I have not brought her-
Revelations in Fall#287.dst: Souv- ...Zhi-Zhi? Tout va bien? Vous... vous avez l'air secoué, c'est quelque chose qu'elle a dit? Je n'aurais pas dû la faire entr-
Revelations in Fall#287.speaker: Xao

Revelations in Fall#288.src: You didn't do anything wrong. She gave me a prime opportunity anyway. A warning before throwing my sequence out of line.
Revelations in Fall#288.dst: Tu n'as rien fait de mal. Elle m'a de toute façon offert une occasion de premier ordre. Un avertissement avant de dérégler ma suite.
Revelations in Fall#288.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#289.src: Xao, I trust you. I need to leave Auburn in your care for a bit while I solve this. Please. Can you handle that?
Revelations in Fall#289.dst: Xao, je te fais confiance. Je dois te confier Auburn quelque temps, le temps de régler ça. S'il te plaît. Tu t'en sens capable?
Revelations in Fall#289.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#290.src: ...oh my, I... It's an honor! I won't let you down, sir!! I'll keep things ship-shape! But, why do you need me for this?
Revelations in Fall#290.dst: ...oh là là, je... Quel honneur! Je ne vous décevrai pas, monsieur!! Tout sera impeccable! Mais pourquoi avez-vous besoin de moi pour ça?
Revelations in Fall#290.speaker: Xao

Revelations in Fall#291.src: ...I need to converge at the Roughworks, handle her work for a while. That, and the next Crown Festival is soon. I feel like...it'd be a disservice to miss it.
Revelations in Fall#291.dst: ...Je dois converger vers Roughworks, reprendre son travail un temps. Et le prochain Festival de la Couronne approche. J'ai l'impression... que le manquer serait une faute.
Revelations in Fall#291.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#292.src: I don't think I have much of
Revelations in Fall#292.dst: Je ne crois pas avoir vraiment le choix.
Revelations in Fall#292.full: I don't think I have much of a choice.

Revelations in Fall#296.src: Th- there- there's no way we c- ca- we can get across the rest of these r- ro- rooftops... one c- cl- one close call is enough f- for me.
Revelations in Fall#296.dst: I- il n'y a- il n'y a pas moyen qu'on t- tra- qu'on traverse le reste de ces t- toi- ces toits... une f- fr- une frayeur me suffit.
Revelations in Fall#296.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#297.dst: On raconte à Wynn des histoires...

Revelations in Fall#299.src: I'm in Fruma to find him.
Revelations in Fall#299.dst: Je suis à Fruma pour le retrouver.

Revelations in Fall#303.src: Mora asked me to make sure y
Revelations in Fall#303.dst: Mora m'a demandé de te ramener saine et sauve.
Revelations in Fall#303.full: Mora asked me to make sure you got home safe.

Revelations in Fall#306.src: You don't have to come along if you don't want to, you know?
Revelations in Fall#306.dst: Tu n'es pas obligée de venir si tu ne veux pas, tu sais?
Revelations in Fall#306.speaker: Player
